channel.title: The Kyiv Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: World’s largest oil producer Aramco in talks to buy Ukrainian interceptor drones, WSJ reports
item.description: Saudi state oil giant Aramco is in talks with two Ukrainian drone makers about buying interceptor drones to protect oil infrastructure from Iranian attacks, according to the Wall Street Journal.

item.title: The Kyiv Independent is raising $63,500 to support injured Ukrainian photojournalist George Ivanchenko
item.description: The Kyiv Independent has launched a fundraiser to support the recovery of George Ivanchenko, a 25-year-old Ukrainian photojournalist who lost his leg in a targeted Russian drone attack while reporting on the front line.

item.title: Ukraine war latest: 'Fuel tanks are burning' — Major Russian oil hub hit in Ukrainian drone strike in Krasnodar Krai
item.description: Key developments on March 12:'Fuel tanks are burning' — Major Russian oil hub hit in Ukrainian drone strike in Krasnodar Krai, SBU source saysWorld’s largest oil producer Aramco in talks to buy Ukrainian interceptor drones, WSJ reportsHungary's unrecognized Druzhba delegation arrives

item.title: Hungary returns Ukrainian bank vehicles but keeps $82 million in gold, cash
item.description: Hungary returned two seized armored vehicles to Ukraine's Oschadbank on March 12 but is withholding cash and gold worth about $82 million amid an ongoing dispute between Budapest and Kyiv.

item.title: ICC opens investigation into alleged crimes against humanity by Belarus
item.description: The International Criminal Court has launched an investigation into alleged crimes against humanity by Belarus after Lithuania referred the case, saying some elements of the alleged crimes occurred on its territory.

item.title: Explosions reported at Russian airfields in occupied Crimea, Krasnodar Krai
item.description: Explosions rang out at Russian airfields in an apparent Ukrainian attack on Russian military targets in the Black Sea region overnight on March 13, Russian Telegram channels reported.

item.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,277,620 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
item.description: The number includes 860 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

item.title: Zelensky arrives in France to meet Macron
item.description: The leaders will discuss French and European support for Ukraine's defense and ways to increase pressure on Russia, namely, by targeting its shadow fleet, the Elysee Palace said earlier.

item.title: US temporarily eases Russian oil sanctions as Iran war drives price surge
item.description: The U.S. Treasury Department issued a temporary license on March 12 to allow countries to purchase Russian oil currently stranded at sea, in an effort to stabilize global energy prices as the war with Iran drives markets higher.

item.title: ​​'Hidden hand of Putin' behind Iranian drone attacks in Middle East, UK Defense Secretary says
item.description: British military officials told Healey Iranian drones were "flying them much lower, and therefore they were more effective."
